title: Brangwyn on Sketching
content: "Always I've had a sketch book on me....""...And it doesn't matter how bad the sketch may be..."Sir Frank Brangwyn, R.A., Portrait of A.H. Mackmurdo, 1 May 1945.Red chalk on cream laid paper.Photo: ©Royal Academy of Arts, London."The fact remains that once I have tried to sketch the object—a mental photograph remains in my mind. Knock me down if I'm wrong."-------From "Brangwyn's Pilgrimage. The Life Story of an Artistby William de Belleroche"Wikipedia on Sir Frank Brangwyn, 1867-1956.
